sources.title: Auto-source sensors
sources.description: For each parameter, optionally pick a sensor whose value will be used as the 'latest' fallback when no manual reading is fresh. Defaults are pre-filled where we know about them (e.g. KH Keeper, ATO probe). Leave a row empty for manual / ICP-only parameters.

targets.title: Target ranges
targets.description: Per-parameter target band (min / max) for your tank. Defaults are pre-filled from the integration's built-in values; override here if your reef runs to different numbers (e.g. SPS-low vs. mixed-reef-high). Empty fields fall back to the default. Surfaced as `target_min` / `target_max` / `in_target_band` attributes on each parameter's `_latest` sensor.

advisor.title: Alk dosing advisor
advisor.description: Configure the alkalinity dosing recommendation engine. **Recommendation-only** — never writes to your doser; you apply changes in ReefBeat manually. Leave 'Enable advisor' off until your KH source is calibrated (calibration warning binary_sensor will tell you). The advisor takes a snapshot once per day at the configured time, builds a rolling window of KH + dose history, and suggests a daily-dose change when the median drifts outside the target band. **First-time setup checklist:** (1) pick your KH source sensor, (2) pick the doser head sensors, (3) confirm tank volume, (4) pick supplement (or leave 'auto' for label-detect), (5) verify target band, (6) flip Enable on.

data_description.advisor_enabled: Master switch. Off → advisor sensor is unavailable, no recommendations, but daily snapshots still capture so history accumulates. Turn on once your KH source is calibrated and you've tested for a few days.
data_description.advisor_alk_head_entity_ids: Pick the **`_daily_dose`** sensor for each RSDose head dosing alkalinity (e.g. `sensor.rsdose4_SERIAL_head_N_daily_dose`). NOT `_auto_dosed_today` (today's actual dose) and NOT `_supplement` (the label). Multiple heads are summed.
data_description.advisor_kh_source: The sensor whose state is your live KH reading. For KH Keeper users: `sensor.kh_keeper_kh`. The advisor takes one snapshot per day from this sensor.
data_description.advisor_calibration_warning_entity: Optional `binary_sensor` that flags when your KH source needs recalibration (e.g. `binary_sensor.kh_keeper_calibration_due_warning`). When ON, the advisor drops confidence to 'low' and notes the warning in the reason text.
data_description.advisor_tank_volume_l: Total water volume in litres. Used to scale the supplement's spec efficiency. Reefer 425 G2 actual water volume is ~425 L (the model name is a hint but verify with your sump fill level).
data_description.advisor_supplement_profile: Pick a registered supplement profile (Foundation B, Tropic Marin Alkalinity Plus, or one you added via `add_supplement_profile`). 'auto' detects from the doser head's `_supplement` label. 'custom' uses the manual efficiency value below.
data_description.advisor_spec_efficiency_dkh_per_mL_per_1: Vendor-published potency. Foundation B = 0.1 dKH per mL per 100L. Used when 'Custom' is selected above, or as fallback when a profile has no stored potency. Once you've acknowledged a few dose changes, the advisor compares observed vs spec and warns if drift exceeds the threshold below.
data_description.advisor_target_min: Lower edge of your KH target band. Default 8.5 dKH (modern reef consensus 8.5-9.0). LPS-tolerant tanks can run 7.5-8.0 to mimic NSW. Whatever you pick, **stability matters more than the number** — Holmes-Farley says don't whip alk by more than 1 dKH/day.
data_description.advisor_target_max: Upper edge. Default 8.9 dKH. Above 11 dKH is dangerous (precipitation + tissue burn). Above 9.5 is fine for LPS but can cause SPS tip burn if Mg is low.
data_description.advisor_window_days: How far back the algorithm looks when computing the median + slope. Default 7 days. Shorter (3-5) reacts faster to changes; longer (14+) smooths out noise. KH Keeper publishes every 6 hours so 7 days = ~28 snapshots.
data_description.advisor_min_samples: Minimum daily snapshots required before the advisor will produce a recommendation. Default 5. Below this, the sensor reports `confidence: insufficient`. Increase if you don't trust your KH source's noise level.
data_description.advisor_min_trend_days: How many consecutive days the median must be outside the target band before the advisor suggests a change. Default 3. Stops a single noisy reading from triggering action — must be a sustained trend.
data_description.advisor_cooldown_days: After you click Acknowledge, the advisor waits this many days before suggesting another change. Default 5 days — gives the new dose time to actually move KH before the algorithm reacts. Increase if your tank responds slowly.
data_description.advisor_dismiss_cooldown_days: After you click Dismiss (ignore the suggestion), wait this many days before re-suggesting. Default 2 days — short because dismissed recommendations might still be valid if conditions persist.
data_description.advisor_step_cap_pct: Max change per recommendation, as % of current dose. Default 10%. Conservative — Holmes-Farley says don't change alk dose by more than 25% in one go to avoid swings. Raise to 15-20% only if you're tracking a slow-but-confirmed trend.
data_description.advisor_hysteresis_dkh: Dead-zone around the target band (in dKH). Default 0.1 — within KH Keeper noise floor. The advisor won't suggest a change unless the median is at least this far OUTSIDE the band. Stops endless tiny adjustments around the boundary.
data_description.advisor_min_samples_after_event: After you log a demand change (e.g. 'added 3 SPS frags'), the advisor enters learning mode and waits for this many post-event snapshots before resuming recommendations. Default 3. The old slope is no longer valid; we need fresh data.
data_description.advisor_correction_period_days: When the algorithm computes a correction, it spreads the dose change over this many days rather than applying it all at once. Default 7. So a 0.7 dKH gap is corrected at 0.1 dKH/day rather than slamming the tank in one day. **This is the rate-of-change safety knob.**
data_description.advisor_snapshot_hour: What hour of the day to capture the daily snapshot (0-23, local time). Default 23 (11 PM). Pick a time when KH is reliably stable — e.g. just before lights off, after the day's dosing has fully equilibrated.
data_description.advisor_snapshot_minute: Minute past the hour for the daily snapshot. Default 55. Combined with hour=23 → 23:55 local time.
data_description.advisor_empirical_drift_pct: When you acknowledge a dose change, the advisor estimates the supplement's actual potency from the before/after KH slope. If the observed value drifts more than this % from spec, you'll see `spec_drift_warning: true` and a note in the reason text. Default 50%. Lower (30%) for a tighter sanity check; higher (75%) if your tank's variance is high.
data_description.advisor_wc_settling_hours: After you log a water change, snapshots taken within this many hours are excluded from the algorithm's slope/median calculation. Default 24h. Stops the dilution event from being misread as a consumption spike. The window itself isn't truncated — just the disturbed snapshots are skipped.

advisor_calcium.title: Calcium dosing advisor
advisor_calcium.description: Configure the Calcium dosing recommendation engine. Recommendation-only — never writes to your doser. Defaults are tuned for **sparse manual testing — 1 to 2 readings per month, up to 4** (the realistic cadence without an auto-tester). 90-day rolling window with min 2 readings before activating, plus a trend rule that requires 2 consecutive out-of-band readings before suggesting a change (so a single noisy reading can't trigger action). 30-day cooldown matches typical monthly testing cadence. If you have an auto-tester (Mastertronic Essential) bump min_samples and shrink window_days for faster response cycles. Snapshots come from your manual Calcium readings — record via the Test Session view; existing readings are auto-backfilled when the advisor first activates.

data.advisor_calcium_spec_efficiency: Spec efficiency (ppm Ca per mL per 100L)
data.advisor_calcium_min_trend_days: Consecutive readings outside band before adjusting
data.advisor_calcium_min_samples_after_event: Required readings after demand change before resuming

data_description.advisor_calcium_heads: Pick the **`_daily_dose`** sensor for each RSDose head that doses Calcium (e.g. `sensor.rsdose4_SERIAL_head_N_daily_dose`). NOT `_auto_dosed_today` (today's actual dose) and NOT `_supplement` (the supplement label). Multiple heads are summed.
data_description.advisor_calcium_supplement_profile: Pick a Calcium-targeting profile registered via `add_supplement_profile` (e.g. Red Sea Foundation A). Use 'Custom' to enter a manual potency below.
data_description.advisor_calcium_spec_efficiency: Vendor-published potency. Foundation A = 2 ppm Ca raise per mL per 100L tank volume. Used when 'Custom' is selected above, or as fallback for profiles without a stored potency.
data_description.advisor_calcium_target_min: SPS-friendly default 420 ppm. Holmes-Farley says 380–450 is fine for any reef; widen for LPS-dominant tanks.
data_description.advisor_calcium_window_days: How far back the algorithm looks. **Default 90 days** for sparse monthly testing (1-2 readings/month accumulates 3-6 readings in 90 days). Reduce to 7 if you have a Ca auto-tester running daily readings.
data_description.advisor_calcium_min_samples: Default 2 readings. Below this, the advisor returns 'insufficient samples'. Bump higher if you test more often and want stronger signal before recommendations fire.
data_description.advisor_calcium_cooldown_days: Default 30 days (one monthly testing cycle) — gives one full cycle to see the effect of a dose change before the advisor suggests another.
data_description.advisor_calcium_step_cap_pct: Default 10% — conservative across reef types. Holmes-Farley: never raise Ca more than 25 ppm/day equivalent.
data_description.advisor_calcium_hysteresis: Default 5 ppm — within typical test-kit noise (Salifert/Hanna ULR ±10–20 ppm). Catches real drifts without chasing kit jitter.
data_description.advisor_calcium_enabled: Master switch. Off → advisor sensor is unavailable. Turn on after you've registered Foundation A as a supplement profile and have a few Ca readings logged.
data_description.advisor_calcium_min_samples: Minimum readings before the advisor will produce a recommendation. **Default 2** for sparse manual cadence — bump to 5+ if you have an auto-tester running daily readings.
data_description.advisor_calcium_min_trend_days: Consecutive out-of-band readings before suggesting a change. **Default 2** — stops a single noisy reading from triggering action; needs at least one confirming reading.
data_description.advisor_calcium_dismiss_cooldown_days: After you click Dismiss, wait this many days before re-suggesting. **Default 14 days**. Shorter than the acknowledge cooldown because dismissed suggestions might still be valid if conditions persist.
data_description.advisor_calcium_min_samples_after_event: After you log a demand change (e.g. 'added 3 SPS frags'), the advisor enters learning mode and waits for this many post-event readings before resuming. **Default 1** — at sparse cadence, waiting for 3 readings would mean 3 months of silence.
data_description.advisor_calcium_correction_period_days: Spreads the correction over this many days rather than slamming it in one go. **Default 30 days** — gentle daily dose changes appropriate for the slow-feedback manual-test loop. **This is the rate-of-change safety knob.**

advisor_magnesium.title: Magnesium dosing advisor
advisor_magnesium.description: Configure the Magnesium dosing recommendation engine. Recommendation-only — never writes to your doser. Mg is more forgiving than Ca/alk (50–100 ppm/day shifts barely register on corals) but Mg is what KEEPS Ca and alk stable — low Mg fails to inhibit CaCO3 precipitation. Holmes-Farley consensus: fix Mg first, then alk + Ca settle. Defaults are tuned for **sparse manual testing — 1 to 2 readings per month** (90-day window, min 2 readings, 30-day cooldown). Snapshots come from your manual Mg readings — record via the Test Session view; existing readings are auto-backfilled when the advisor first activates.

data.advisor_magnesium_spec_efficiency: Spec efficiency (ppm Mg per mL per 100L)
data.advisor_magnesium_min_trend_days: Consecutive readings outside band before adjusting
data.advisor_magnesium_min_samples_after_even: Required readings after demand change before resuming

data_description.advisor_magnesium_heads: Pick the **`_daily_dose`** sensor for each RSDose head that doses Magnesium (e.g. `sensor.rsdose4_SERIAL_head_N_daily_dose`). NOT `_auto_dosed_today` (today's actual dose). Multiple heads are summed.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_supplement_profile: Pick a Magnesium-targeting profile registered via `add_supplement_profile` (e.g. Red Sea Foundation C). Use 'Custom' to enter a manual potency below.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_spec_efficiency: Vendor-published potency. Foundation C = 1 ppm Mg raise per mL per 100L tank volume. Used when 'Custom' is selected above, or as fallback for profiles without a stored potency.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_target_min: SPS-friendly default 1300 ppm. Natural seawater ~1280; LPS tolerant down to 1200.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_window_days: How far back the algorithm looks. **Default 90 days** for sparse monthly testing.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_hysteresis: Default 20 ppm — within typical Mg test-kit noise (kits read in coarser units than Ca, ±20-30 ppm common). Catches real drifts without chasing kit jitter.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_enabled: Master switch. Off → advisor sensor is unavailable. Mg moves slowly so even partial config + manual testing is fine to leave on.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_min_samples: **Default 2** for sparse cadence. Mg is forgiving — even 2 readings spaced weeks apart show a useful trend.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_cooldown_days: **Default 30 days** — Mg moves slowly. Wait for the next monthly test to see if the dose change worked before suggesting another.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_dismiss_cooldown_days: **Default 14 days**. Mg dismissals are easier to justify since Mg drifts slowly — short cooldown lets the advisor re-suggest if the trend persists.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_step_cap_pct: **Default 10%** — same conservative cap as Ca/alk. Mg overshoots are more forgiving but the cap protects against pump miscalibration.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_min_samples_after_even: **Default 1** post-event reading. Mg-affecting events are rare (water change, large salt batch swap) — usually one fresh reading is enough to confirm the new baseline.
data_description.advisor_magnesium_correction_period_days: **Default 30 days** — Mg corrections want gentle nudges. Tank can sit at 1280 ppm safely while you ramp toward 1320.

advisor_nitrate.title: Nitrate dosing advisor
advisor_nitrate.description: Configure the Nitrate dosing recommendation engine. Recommendation-only — never writes to your doser. **NO3 supplements are REMOVERS** (NPX, Quantum HR/LR Nitrate Remover) — raising the dose REDUCES NO3. Spec efficiency is therefore NEGATIVE (e.g. -0.5 = 1 mL per 100L removes 0.5 ppm NO3 over the correction period). Modern reef target is 1–10 ppm; the old 'ULNS / 0 ppm' approach is abandoned because too-low NO3 starves zoox and triggers dinoflagellates. A **floor guard** refuses any further increase in removal dose when NO3 is at/below 0.5 ppm. The advisor also computes the NO3:PO4 ratio (Redfield) and flags imbalance (cyano risk if PO4 too high relative to NO3, dino risk if reversed). Defaults are tuned for **sparse manual testing — 1 to 2 readings per month** (90-day window, min 2 readings, 30-day cooldown). Snapshots come from your manual Nitrate readings — record via the Test Session view.

data.advisor_nitrate_spec_efficiency: Spec efficiency (ppm NO3 per mL per 100L; NEGATIVE for removers)
data.advisor_nitrate_min_trend_days: Consecutive readings outside band before adjusting
data.advisor_nitrate_min_samples_after_event: Required readings after demand change before resuming

data_description.advisor_nitrate_heads: Pick the **`_daily_dose`** sensor for each RSDose head that doses an NO3 remover (NPX, HR/LR Nitrate Remover). Multiple heads are summed.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_supplement_profile: Pick a Nitrate-targeting remover profile registered via `add_supplement_profile`. Use 'Custom' to enter a manual potency below.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_spec_efficiency: **NEGATIVE for removers.** Default -0.5 ppm NO3 reduction per mL per 100L (rough NPX/HR-Nitrate average — bacterial response varies wildly with population size). Use 'Custom' and override here as you observe actual potency.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_target_min: Modern consensus 1 ppm. Below 0.5 ppm triggers dinoflagellates per BRStv 52 Weeks.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_target_max: Modern consensus 10 ppm. SPS-leaning target lower (5 ppm); LPS tolerates higher (up to 20 ppm).
data_description.advisor_nitrate_window_days: **Default 90 days** for sparse monthly testing. Carbon-dose response is non-linear; longer window smooths bacterial-population variance.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_step_cap_pct: Default 10% — conservative because remover potency varies with bacterial population. Big jumps risk overshooting and bottoming out NO3.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_hysteresis: Default 0.5 ppm — within Salifert NO3 test-kit precision.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_enabled: Master switch. Off → advisor sensor is unavailable. **Watch the floor guard** — if NO3 ≤ 0.5 ppm the advisor refuses to recommend more removal.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_min_samples: **Default 2** for sparse cadence — NO3 readings monthly is common.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_min_trend_days: **Default 2** consecutive readings outside band before adjusting.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_cooldown_days: **Default 30 days** — bacterial response to carbon-source changes is slow (population needs 2-4 weeks to adapt). Don't recompute faster than that.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_min_samples_after_event: **Default 1** post-event reading. Demand-change events for NO3 = stocking changes (more fish → more NO3 production) or feeding changes.
data_description.advisor_nitrate_correction_period_days: **Default 30 days** — long correction period because remover potency varies. Spread the recovery so an overestimate doesn't strip NO3 below the floor.

advisor_phosphate.title: Phosphate dosing advisor
advisor_phosphate.description: Configure the Phosphate dosing recommendation engine. Recommendation-only — never writes to your doser. **PO4 supplements are REMOVERS** (Quantum AR Phosphate, NPX, lanthanum chloride solutions) — raising the dose REDUCES PO4. Spec efficiency is NEGATIVE (e.g. -0.04 = 1 mL per 100L removes 0.04 ppm PO4 over the correction period). Modern target is 0.03–0.10 ppm; below 0.02 ppm triggers dinoflagellates. A **floor guard** refuses any further increase in removal dose when PO4 is at/below 0.03 ppm. The advisor also computes the NO3:PO4 ratio (Redfield) and flags imbalance. Defaults are tuned for **sparse manual testing**. Snapshots come from your manual Phosphate readings — record via the Test Session view.

data.advisor_phosphate_spec_efficiency: Spec efficiency (ppm PO4 per mL per 100L; NEGATIVE for removers)
data.advisor_phosphate_min_trend_days: Consecutive readings outside band before adjusting
data.advisor_phosphate_min_samples_after_even: Required readings after demand change before resuming

data_description.advisor_phosphate_heads: Pick the **`_daily_dose`** sensor for each RSDose head that doses a PO4 remover (Quantum AR, lanthanum solution, NPX). Multiple heads are summed.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_supplement_profile: Pick a Phosphate-targeting remover profile registered via `add_supplement_profile`. Use 'Custom' to enter a manual potency below.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_spec_efficiency: **NEGATIVE for removers.** Default -0.04 ppm PO4 reduction per mL per 100L (lanthanum stoichiometry). Override per your specific product as you observe actual potency.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_target_min: Modern consensus 0.03 ppm. Below 0.02 triggers dinoflagellates.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_target_max: Modern consensus 0.10 ppm. SPS prefers 0.03–0.06; LPS tolerates 0.05–0.10.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_step_cap_pct: Default 10% — conservative. Lanthanum overdosing strips PO4 fast and can shock corals.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_hysteresis: Default 0.01 ppm — within Hanna ULR PO4 precision.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_enabled: Master switch. **Watch the floor guard** — if PO4 ≤ 0.03 ppm the advisor refuses to recommend more removal (dinoflagellate prevention).
data_description.advisor_phosphate_min_samples: **Default 2** — Hanna ULR PO4 readings monthly is typical.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_cooldown_days: **Default 30 days** — lanthanum / GFO response is fast (hours-days), but the recommendation cycle should match testing cadence.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_window_days: How far back the algorithm looks. **Default 90 days** for sparse monthly testing.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_min_samples_after_even: **Default 1** post-event reading. PO4 demand-change events = stocking, food-bio source changes, lanthanum recharge.
data_description.advisor_phosphate_correction_period_days: **Default 30 days** — gentle ramping. Stripping PO4 hard with lanthanum can shock corals; conservative correction period keeps the rate of change low.
